source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 5-year estimates

tables.B25074: Household income by gross rent as a percentage of household income

notes: vehiclesPerAdult = average vehicles per household / average adults per household. Cars follow drivers, so the denominator is adults (18+), not household size.
The engine multiplies this by the adults implied by filing status, then rounds — see PROJECT.md D17.
The "5 or more vehicles" bucket is counted as exactly 5, marginally understating a few rural metros.
